svg.title: GLM-5.2 FP8 intuitive decode cache policy
svg.text: One decode layer: K2 chooses the policy working set, U2 limits cache updates
1. Select the K2 policy working set
K=2: only the highlighted router ranks affect cache policy
K2 active set = {E4, E7, E12, E23}
2. Lookup K2 experts in Experts Cache
Misses remain CPU candidates unless selected by U2.
The complete router top-8 is classified after the update.
3. Protect hits and select U2 victims
E12 replaces E1 · E23 replaces E9
Selected misses are staged in Decode Buffer; only the short commit writes Experts Cache.
5. Execute all router top-8 routes using the published map
existing cache hits + U2 updated experts
K2 changes cache protection/update decisions; it does not change GLM's top-8 routing semantics.
Figure 4. Decode K2/U2 cache policy: protect hits, replace two victims, then split GPU and CPU work.
